canonical_work.title: Language Atlas of India 1991
canonical_work.corporate_author: Census of India / Office of the Registrar General, India
canonical_work.scope: Historical 1991 Census geographical distribution and speaker counts for Munda and Mundari; non-Mundarica source.

verified_locator.heading: Distribution of Monpa, Munda, Mundari and Nicobarese Languages 1991
verified_locator.notes: Indexed full text explicitly states 413,894 Munda speakers and 861,378 Mundari speakers in the 1991 Census, gives state/district distributions, and distinguishes the two census labels. These are historical Census classifications and must not be silently collapsed into current community identity or current language classification.
